remarks: Perched high above the Goodwives River, this stunning Mid-Century Modern home offers sophisticated living in an extraordinary natural setting. Walls of floor-to-ceiling glass invite the outdoors in, seamlessly blending interior spaces with the serene beauty of the 1.8-acre private landscape. Reimagined by renowned architectural firm Joeb Moore + Partners, highlights include a dramatic cantilevered IPE deck that spans the back of the home-evoking the feeling of a treehouse floating in space. Superior finishes throughout this carefully curated home include warm walnut floors, a striking steel-wrapped fireplace, and vaulted ceilings that amplify the natural light. An entertainer's dream, this home is perfect for hosting family and friends-or simply curling up in one of the many cozy window nooks to watch the changing seasons and abundant wildlife. Ideally located just steps from the vibrant Corbin District-Darien's transformative downtown destination featuring NYC-caliber dining and boutique shopping yet only moments from the waterfront sanctuary of Great Island. A rare and inspired opportunity for design-forward, nature-infused convenient living within the award-winning Darien school district.
